title: Digestion and Bead Cleanup
author: Opentrons
materials: Pause protocol (‘move sample plate to heater shaker’)
Pause protocol (‘move sample plate to magnetic mod’)

steps.title: Load reservoir with solvents
steps.instruction: Fill the 12‑well reservoir: well A1 with 100 % ACN and well A2 with 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Verify rack contents
steps.instruction: Check the Eppendorf rack: A1 contains bead solution, A2 200 mM TEAB, A3 5 % HA, and A4 20 % formic acid.

steps.title: Homogenize bead solution
steps.instruction: Homogenize the bead solution in rack position A1 by pipetting 50 µL three times at fast speed.

steps.title: Transfer beads to plate
steps.instruction: Using the same tips, dispense 4 µL of bead solution from rack A1 into columns 1‑6 of slot 1.

steps.title: Transfer sample to bead plate
steps.instruction: With a fresh tip for each column, transfer 30 µL of sample from slot 2 columns 1‑6 to the corresponding columns of slot 1.

steps.title: Add ACN to bead plate
steps.instruction: For each column of slot 1, aspirate 70 µL of 100 % ACN (air‑gap), dispense into the well, then mix three times at low speed; use a new tip for each column.

steps.title: Incubate 2 minutes
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Engage magnetic module
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module, positioning the magnetic beads as low as possible.

steps.title: Incubate 5 minutes
steps.instruction: Wait 5 minutes with the magnet engaged.

steps.title: Remove supernatant to waste
steps.instruction: Using the same tips, aspirate 100 µL from each column of slot 1 and dispense into reservoir well 11 (consolidate).

steps.title: Ethanol wash #1
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 70 % ethanol to each column of slot 1 using a single tip.

steps.title: Remove ethanol wash #1
steps.instruction: Aspirate 100 µL from each column of slot 1 and dispense into reservoir well 11 (consolidate) using the same tip.

steps.title: Ethanol wash #2
steps.instruction: Repeat the ethanol wash: add 100 µL 70 % ethanol to each column of slot 1 (one tip) and then remove 100 µL to reservoir well 11 (same tip).

steps.title: Disengage magnetic module
steps.instruction: Turn off the magnetic module.

steps.title: Incubate 2 minutes
steps.instruction: Wait 2 minutes before the next step.

steps.title: Add digestion solution
steps.instruction: With a fresh tip for each column, add 10 µL digestion solution to columns 1‑6 of slot 1 and mix once at slow speed.

steps.title: Move plate to heater shaker
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol and manually move the sample plate to the heater‑shaker module.

steps.title: Close heater‑shaker module
steps.instruction: Close the heater‑shaker (HS) module.

steps.title: Heat overnight at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Activate the heater at 37 °C and pause the protocol for overnight digestion.

steps.title: Deactivate heater
steps.instruction: Turn off the heater after the overnight incubation.

steps.title: Open heater‑shaker module
steps.instruction: Open the HS module to retrieve the plate.

steps.title: Move plate to magnetic module
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol and move the sample plate back to the magnetic module.

steps.title: Engage magnetic module again
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module, keeping beads as low as possible.

steps.title: Incubate 2 minutes
steps.instruction: Wait 2 minutes with the magnet engaged.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to new wells
steps.instruction: Using fresh tips, aspirate 10 µL from each column of slot 1 and dispense to the designated new positions in the same plate (low‑speed aspirate, away from beads, touch tip after dispense).

steps.title: Add TEAB to TMT wells
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of 200 mM TEAB to every TMT well with a new tip each, mixing three times.

steps.title: Add TMT/buffer mix
steps.instruction: From slot 9, add 9 µL TMT/buffer mix to each sample according to the attached TMT layout (new tip each, mix three times at low speed).

steps.title: Incubate 1 hour
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol for 1 hour.

steps.title: Add 5 % HA
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of 5 % HA to all samples (new tip each, mix once at medium speed).

steps.title: Incubate 15 minutes
steps.instruction: Wait 15 minutes.

steps.title: Consolidate samples into Eppendorf
steps.instruction: Combine every two columns of samples into one Eppendorf tube located in slots B5‑8 of slot 3 (e.g., for triplicates: columns 7+8 → B5, 9+10 → B6, 11+12 → B7; for monoplicates: columns 3+4 → B5).

steps.title: Add formic acid and mix
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of 20 % formic acid to each tube in slots B5‑8 of slot 3, using a new tip each time, and mix three times at high speed.
